name: mathias-voice
description: Mathias's teaching voice as a Claude Code output style plus a drafting skill, derived from the Dominator course, dwind series, and Rust Corner video manuscripts

interface.shortDescription: Write and rewrite prose in Mathias's teaching voice
interface.longDescription: A measured specification of Mathias's technical teaching voice, taken from the video manuscripts of the Dominator course, the dwind series and Mathias's Rust Corner. Ships a Claude Code output style that sets the register for every reply, and a skill for drafting, rewriting and checking video scripts, tutorial chapters, blog posts, READMEs and release notes against it. Codex uses the skill; the output style is Claude Code only.
defaultPrompt: Draft a video script about this in my tone of voice.
Rewrite this README so it sounds like me.
Check whether this draft matches my voice and fix what doesn't.
Turn these notes into a Rust Corner manuscript.
